High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready copy of the Players Committee virtual card [[Anger, Fear, Aggression (V) (Errata)]] (Virtual Set 0, Light Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Virtual Cards/Set 0/Light/Anger Fear Aggression.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B8qrn2aDKgPeZjZqNmZjaWlJcU0/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Anger Fear Aggression.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,700 bytes, SHA-256 <code>b1564bc44cc6c07113ad21f65d859bd491baa0a5f98ba6f0b3f469da4e82ac90</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 44.0, 47.5, 72.5, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:V0-L-angerfearaggression.gif]].

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
